item.title: Wellesley updates financial aid policy for families making under 150K
item.description: Wellesley College updated its website in January 2026, stating that beginning in fall 2026, students whose families earn less than $150,000 a year with typical assets be tuition-free, though the Student Financial Services (SFS) clarified that financial aid awards may not actually differ.
